newsitem.title: USA: First Union Real Estate criticizes letter.
newsitem.headline: First Union Real Estate criticizes letter.

text.p: First Union Real Estate Investments said Tuesday that it has received an unsolicited letter from Gotham Partners that is critical of its management and strategic plan.
The company said in a statement that while "it welcomed comments from its shareholders, it was managing the business for the long-term and intended to stay the course."

"Our board and management have operated with integrity and honesty in making decisions that are in the interest of all shareholders," Chairman, President and Chief Executive James Mastandrea said in a statement. "The Gotham proposal lacks appeal because it serves their own short-term purposes and would deprive long-term shareholders of maximum returns over time."
The company said that gotham has a 1.9 million share position, of which 1.2 million is in options.
First Union has more than 35 million shares outstanding on a fully converted basis.
First Union is a real estate investment trust.
